candidates.name: chinese_bigram_confusion_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Replacing the ASCII-only tokenizer with Chinese character bigrams will give the confusion-disambiguation selection algorithm meaningful Jaccard scores (vs. near-zero for all pairs), enabling it to retrieve genuinely similar examples and improving val accuracy above 26%.

candidates.name: reflexion_lesson_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Storing LLM-distilled correction rules (Reflexion-style) instead of raw examples will achieve higher val accuracy than 26% by capturing generalizable error patterns with explicit guidance, without the noise of irrelevant raw examples.
